description.en: A source-verified MiniMax H3 music video prompt with attached video evidence from @Cardoso.
description.zh: 由原作者公开 X 帖提供并已核验视频结果的 MiniMax H3音乐视频提示词。

prompt:
Style: Adult animated television comedy in the distinctive flat-vector / limited-animation style of a suave-spy cartoon. Bold inked outlines, flat cel-shaded colors, slightly stiff comedic timing, hard graphic shadows, subtle film-grain texture. 2K, cinematic but comedic.

Setting: A bright sunny beach. Clear blue sky, soft sand, ocean waves in the background.

Characters:
Sterling Archer: a handsome secret agent with jet-black slicked-back hair, wearing a tight dark swimsuit. Self-satisfied, manic energy, perpetually smug.
Lana Kane: a tall, striking brown-skinned female agent, wearing a stylish bikini. Exasperated, eyes-wide "are-you-kidding-me" energy.

Shot 1 (0:00–0:03): Medium shot of Archer and Lana standing on the beach. Archer cups his hands around his mouth and calls out: <d>[English] Lana? Lana? LANA!!!!</d>

Shot 2 (0:03–0:05): Cut to Lana turning sharply toward him, annoyed: <d>[English] What?!</d>

Shot 3 (0:05–0:07): Archer leans in with a smug grin: <d>[English] With MiniMax any internet pervert can draw us!</d>

Shot 4 (0:07–0:08): Lana frowns, confused: <d>[English] What do you mean?</d>

Shot 5 (0:08–0:09): Archer points at her with a knowing look: <d>[English] They can even change your clothes!</d>

Shot 6 (0:09–0:10): Quick flash. Lana’s bikini instantly becomes a modern one-piece swimsuit. She looks down in surprise.

Shot 7 (0:10–0:11): Another quick flash. The swimsuit changes into a 1920s-style bathing suit. Lana’s eyes widen further.

Shot 8 (0:11–0:13): Final flash. The bathing suit disappears completely. Lana is suddenly naked and quickly covers herself with both hands, shocked and angry: <d>[English] Archer, stop that!</d>

Shot 9 (0:13–0:15): Archer raises both hands defensively, looking genuine: <d>[English] That’s not me!</d>

overall_soundscape: Soft ocean waves and light beach ambience. Clear comedic dialogue with sharp cuts between the clothing changes.

non_diegetic_music: None. Dry, absurd, self-aware comedic timing.
